patch_description: The current program regressed to 2.10 versus the earlier 2.42 program. The key differences: (1) the earlier program generated a diverse pool of seed layouts (multiple row-count patterns × stretch factors × jittered variants) rather than a single fixed hex core, and (2) it refined positions with a deterministic greedy nudge toward free space, keeping only improvements. Layout diversity in the seed pool is what drives the score. I restore that framework and enhance it: add corner-filler seed variants (small circles tucked into the four corners alongside the hex core, which the current program showed helps), add wall-contact variants of the row layouts, and use the monotone Gauss-Seidel radius grower with a final greedy position refinement pass. Each candidate gets its radii grown exactly, positions nudged toward free space, and only improving configurations are kept, so validity remains 1.0.
